notes.title: New update: DPAD, keyboard setup, new level and more
notes.content:
Hi guys!
First, thank you for your support and your feedback! :16bitHeart:

:16bitStar:  We have released a new update, here the features: :16bitStar:

- DPAD for Xbox controllers now works.
- Now you can remap the keyboard keys.
- Now you can select the port/input of your controllers.
- Added new level FREE DLC: Super BOO Quest.
- Added new achievement: Super BOO Quest.
- Fixed attack boxes of the player and the enemies.
- Improve some graphics sprites and animation.
- Fixed some glitches.

Thank you to playing SEEP Universe, we want improve our work to make a good experiece for all users! Thanks! :16bitHeart:

notes.title: New Update (4.3) and new level and achievement!
notes.content:
Hi, guys!
We have released a update for SEEP Universe and a new free dlc level inspired by Halloween!

Now the game have a lots of new features:

- New level.
- New achievement.
- Now you can setting the volume.
- Pause menu with the option to back in the maps.
- Fixed some sounds.

How set up the keyboard:

- Open the game
- Switch the Keyboard
- Click on "setup"
- Press two time the left button of the mouse on Keyboard space

Screenshoots:
http://1.bp.blogspot.com/-U_5npeKWDnI/Vd0sEXUx7XI/AAAAAAAANM8/L5Q_e_F7P3g/s1600/1.png
http://1.bp.blogspot.com/-A7wcweCaafI/Vd0svyRhK3I/AAAAAAAANNM/vy00reVgUUg/s1600/2.jpg

Thank you guys for your feedback, this allowed to improve SEEP Universe! ː16bitHeartː

notes.title: Update REBIRTH (4.0)
notes.content:
Thanks for your feedbacks we have released a new update: Rebirth (4.0)!

Now the game have a lots of new features:

- Change the commands, now the game use only 2 action button for a better feeling.
- Add DLC World (FREE), where you can play extra levels, the first of them is for Christmas!
- Add dynamic map for all worlds.
- Add "crouching down".
- Add 16:9.
- Fixed some animation.
- Fixed some graphics.
- Fixed Screenshot for Steam



How set up the keyboard:

- Open the game 
- Switch the Keyboard 
- Click on "setup" 
- Press two time the left button of the mouse on Keyboard space 

Screenshoots: 
http://1.bp.blogspot.com/-U_5npeKWDnI/Vd0sEXUx7XI/AAAAAAAANM8/L5Q_e_F7P3g/s1600/1.png 
http://1.bp.blogspot.com/-A7wcweCaafI/Vd0svyRhK3I/AAAAAAAANNM/vy00reVgUUg/s1600/2.jpg 

ː16bitStarː ː16bitStarː Thank you guys for your feedback, this allowed to improve SEEP Universe and Merry Christmas! ː16bitStarːː16bitStarː

[i]- Added the achievements!

- Added change resolution just with alt+enter

- Fixed some animation and speed movements
